Summary: LA01: To verify my identity online
Description: As a farm customer, I want to verify my identity online, so that I can start my application without visiting an office.
Acceptance Criteria: Identity verified through the approved verification service; failed checks routed to RM; result logged.
Epic: F9: Identity and beneficial ownership check

Summary: LA02: Beneficial owners of farm corporations captured
Description: As a compliance officer, I want beneficial owners of farm corporations captured, so that we know who ultimately owns and controls the business.
Acceptance Criteria: All owners with 25% or more captured and verified before checklist is shown.
Epic: F9: Identity and beneficial ownership check

Summary: LA03: A checklist for my exact loan type and farm structure
Description: As a farm customer, I want a checklist for my exact loan type and farm structure, so that I only send what is needed.
Acceptance Criteria: Checklist rules for operating lines and equipment loans, by sole owner, partnership and corporation; approved by Credit.

Summary: LA04: Checklist rules maintained in one table
Description: As a Credit adjudicator, I want checklist rules maintained in one table, so that policy changes are made once.
Acceptance Criteria: Rules editable by authorized Credit Policy users only; every change logged.

Summary: LA05: To apply online in English or French
Description: As a farm customer, I want to apply online in English or French, so that I can apply in my language at any time.
Acceptance Criteria: All screens and messages in both languages; save and return within 30 days.

Summary: LA06: The form to work on my phone
Description: As a farm customer, I want the form to work on my phone, so that I can apply from the farm.
Acceptance Criteria: Passes mobile usability test with 5 customers; WCAG 2.1 AA.

Summary: LA07: To start an application on behalf of a customer
Description: As an RM, I want to start an application on behalf of a customer, so that customers who prefer help are not left behind.
Acceptance Criteria: RM can start, customer can finish or RM completes with customer consent recorded.

Summary: LA08: To upload documents from my phone or computer
Description: As a farm customer, I want to upload documents from my phone or computer, so that everything is in one place.
Acceptance Criteria: PDF, JPG, PNG up to 25 MB; upload confirmation shown and emailed.

Summary: LA09: All customer documents attached to the application
Description: As an RM, I want all customer documents attached to the application, so that I stop searching my inbox.
Acceptance Criteria: Documents tagged to checklist item; visible to RM and Credit.

Summary: LA10: Documents stored encrypted in Canada with retention rules
Description: As a privacy officer, I want documents stored encrypted in Canada with retention rules, so that customer data is protected.
Acceptance Criteria: Encryption at rest and in transit; retention applied by document type.

Summary: LA11: To be told instantly if something is missing
Description: As a farm customer, I want to be told instantly if something is missing, so that I can fix it before I submit.
Acceptance Criteria: Missing or expired items flagged on upload; submit blocked until mandatory items present or RM override with reason.

Summary: LA12: Basic document checks (right year, right entity, readable)
Description: As a Credit adjudicator, I want basic document checks (right year, right entity, readable), so that files reach me complete.
Acceptance Criteria: Checks year of financial statements, entity name match, file readable; results shown to RM.

Summary: LA13: To see a completeness score before I review
Description: As an RM, I want to see a completeness score before I review, so that I focus on judgement, not checklists.
Acceptance Criteria: Score from 0 to 100% with list of gaps.

Summary: LA14: Application data sent to the LOS automatically
Description: As an RM, I want application data sent to the LOS automatically, so that I never retype it.
Acceptance Criteria: All mapped fields populate the LOS; validation errors returned to RM within 1 minute.

Summary: LA15: Field level validation on transfer
Description: As Lending Operations, I want field level validation on transfer, so that errors are caught before funding.
Acceptance Criteria: Invalid postal codes, legal names and amounts rejected with clear message.

Summary: LA16: Every transfer logged
Description: As the Domain Lead, I want every transfer logged, so that data errors can be traced.
Acceptance Criteria: Transfer log with time, fields and result kept for audit.

Summary: LA17: To see where my application is
Description: As a farm customer, I want to see where my application is, so that I don't need to call.
Acceptance Criteria: Stages: Received, Under RM review, With Credit, Decision, Documents, Funded; updates within 15 minutes.
Epic: F6: Customer and RM status tracker

Summary: LA18: An email or text when my status changes
Description: As a farm customer, I want an email or text when my status changes, so that I don't have to keep checking.
Acceptance Criteria: Notification preference in English or French; opt out available.
Epic: F6: Customer and RM status tracker

Summary: LA19: To see an application's status
Description: As a Customer Service Centre agent, I want to see an application's status, so that I can answer customers on the first call.
Acceptance Criteria: Read only status view after identity confirmation of the caller.
Epic: F12: Customer Service Centre status view

Summary: LA20: To sign loan documents electronically
Description: As a farm customer, I want to sign loan documents electronically, so that I don't drive to an office in seeding season.
Acceptance Criteria: E-signature through the approved provider; signed copy stored and sent to customer.

Summary: LA21: Signed documents returned to the loan file automatically
Description: As Lending Operations, I want signed documents returned to the loan file automatically, so that funding is not delayed.
Acceptance Criteria: Signed package attached to LOS file and status updated to Documents signed.

Summary: LA22: A dashboard of my open applications by stage
Description: As an RM, I want a dashboard of my open applications by stage, so that I can plan my week.
Acceptance Criteria: Shows count by stage, ageing, and items waiting on the customer.

Summary: LA23: Team level views
Description: As a lending manager, I want team level views, so that I can balance workload in peak season.
Acceptance Criteria: Filter by office and RM; refreshed hourly.
